stage: Concept exploration, not selected production identity
method: Built-in image generation; marks are concept sketches, presentation wordmarks typeset separately

concepts.title: Q 形通道
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE highly refined standalone vector-style brand symbol for CloudQ Gateway, a professional gateway connecting enterprise chat, cloud diagnostic agents and operations alerts. Concept A — Q PORTAL. The form is a proprietary capital Q reduced to a bold architectural rounded-square portal with a large open central counter; its lower right corner flows out into one short decisive diagonal exit stroke, expressing passage through a gateway. A memorable elegant asymmetric notch at the transition should make this more than a font Q. Confident, precise, reliable, quiet. The Q must read immediately at 16 px. Extremely simple: ONE integrated silhouette, broad consistent weight, optically resolved curves, spacious inner counter, no tiny seams. SOLID BLACK #111111 only with genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Center symbol in a square canvas, mark occupying approximately 74% width and 74% height with generous empty margins. Flat crisp vector-like edges. ICON ONLY: absolutely no text, no words, no labels, no mockups, no surrounding tile or container. No gradients, shadows, outlines, 3D, decorative dots, circuits, sparkle or infinity motif. Do not use CA, CloudAgent, letter A, Tencent or WeChat logos. Draw an original symbol, not a copy of any famous brand. This is an initial logo concept study, prioritize extremely elegant professional identity design.

concepts.title: 双向汇流
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE exceptional standalone vector-style brand symbol for CloudQ Gateway, a professional gateway routing enterprise messages into cloud operations diagnosis and delivering answers. Concept B — RELAY / TWO WAY FLOW. An abstract brand mark composed of TWO complementary broad sculpted ribbon/ bracket shapes passing each other through an offset central gap. Each shape has one round 180 degree return and one straight terminal; the interplay creates a compact asymmetrical interlocking silhouette, two-way exchange, and a clear white channel between the two shapes. Distinct from a chain link, generic sync arrows, wifi icon or infinity sign. It should evoke precisely engineered message routing, immediate movement and connection without literal arrowheads or extra nodes. Horizontal/diagonal visual energy, robust rounded terminals, meticulously consistent geometry. Both shapes same SOLID BLACK #111111, on genuinely TRANSPARENT background. No overlap that loses the crucial white channel. High-end modern identity design; simple enough to work at 16 px. Center in a square canvas, symbol occupies approximately 74% width and 65% height. ICON ONLY, no letters, no words, no labels, no mockup, no background tile or enclosing box. No gradients, shadows, decorative dots, circuits, sparkles, 3D or third element. No CA, CloudAgent or letter A. Original symbol, no imitation of famous brands.

concepts.title: 云端回声
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE refined standalone flat vector-style symbol for CloudQ Gateway, a professional gateway connecting cloud diagnosis to enterprise conversations. Concept C — CLOUD ECHO. Fuse a cloud and a dialogue/response into ONE bold distinctive outer silhouette: an asymmetrical compact cloud canopy with exactly TWO broad lobes, a firm nearly horizontal lower contour, and ONE short diagonal conversation tail at the lower right. Inside, carve a single large simple offset rounded white counter so the entire contour also subtly suggests a Q. It should read as a cloud answering a question, not an ordinary outline weather icon. Friendly but dependable, authoritative developer product rather than cute cartoon. Intentionally asymmetrical height profile, excellent optical balance, carefully drawn generous curves, thick body with large negative space, sophisticated identity studio craft. SOLID BLACK #111111 with genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Center in square canvas, symbol occupies approximately 76% width and 62% height. ICON ONLY, no words, no letters as separate objects, no labels or mockups, no framing tile or enclosing badge. No gradients, shadows, fine strokes, eyes, smiley face, circuits, sparkle, extra dots or 3D. No CA, CloudAgent, letter A, Tencent or WeChat logos. One original memorable silhouette that remains readable when tiny.
